card.p: Full ingest-to-answer RAG pipelines using LangChain's retriever and chain primitives, paired with LlamaIndex for document-heavy retrieval quality, covering chunking, embedding, hybrid search, and answer generation.

Agents that orchestrate multiple retrieval steps, re-rank results, and call external tools based on intermediate findings, built with explicit state graphs and checkpointing for production reliability.
Systems that connect your RAG pipeline to live business tools—databases, internal APIs, third-party services—so the AI can fetch real-time data and take actions beyond static text generation.
Chatbots and assistants that maintain context across a conversation or across sessions, tuned to your specific need: short-term context, long-term preference memory, or both.
Review and improvement of an existing RAG implementation, or migration support for teams adding agentic capability to a retrieval-only pipeline.

card cta-card.p: Part of the engagement is an honest read on whether RAG is even the right fit for your data and use case.

card.p: A scoped RAG pipeline build delivered as a fixed-price, milestone-based engagement with clear deliverables from ingest to answer.
Architecture review or debugging support for an existing RAG implementation, including retrieval quality analysis and pipeline optimization.
Ongoing RAG pipeline development for businesses with a continuing AI roadmap requiring iterative improvement and new data source integration.
